name: AutoDeafen
description: Deafens you on Discord when a run passes a per-level, per-startpos percent. No keybind needed.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the whole mod.

undeafen-on-pause.name: Un-deafen while paused
undeafen-on-pause.description: If the mod deafened you this attempt, un-deafen when you pause the game and re-deafen when you resume.

trigger-in-practice.name: Deafen in practice mode
trigger-in-practice.description: Also trigger deafens during practice mode attempts.

delivery-mode.name: Delivery mode
delivery-mode.description: <cy>discord</c>: talk to Discord directly (recommended; one-time Authorize popup, no keybind). <cy>keystroke</c>: tap a key you've bound to <cy>Toggle Deafen</c> in Discord — <cl>Windows only</c>. Desktop Discord on macOS reads global keybinds at the hardware level and cannot see synthetic key presses, and Wine/Proton input never reaches native apps.

discord-connect.name: Discord connection
discord-connect.description: Authorize AutoDeafen with your Discord desktop client. Click <cy>Connect</c>, then hit <cy>Authorize</c> in the popup that appears <cl>inside Discord</c>. Only needed once — the connection resumes automatically afterwards.

keybind.name: Deafen key
keybind.description: The key AutoDeafen taps — set the same combo as your Discord <cy>Toggle Deafen</c> keybind.
